summaries: A Form 10-Q quarterly report for BioLargo, Inc. for the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Consolidated Statements of Operations report Selling, general and administrative expenses of $2,225,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2024. This filing supplies BioLargo's specific administrative expense data for the period to be compared against the other companies in the collection.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Blue Dolphin Energy Company for the period ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Consolidated Statements of Income report "General and administrative expenses" of $983,000 and "Other operating expenses" of $140,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2024. Included within the "Total cost of operations" ($1,999,000) is a "LEH operating fee, related party" of $172,000, alongside depreciation and amortization of $704,000. Segment information further details "Other operating and general and administrative expenses" at $1,295,000 excluding depreciation and interest. This document supplies Blue Dolphin's specific operating and administrative expense figures to enable comparison with the other companies in the collection.

A Form 10-Q quarterly report for Hugoton Royalty Trust for the quarter ended March 31, 2024. Relevant to the task: The Condensed Statements of Distributable Income report "Administration expense" of $228,423 for the three months ended March 31, 2024. Unlike the corporate entities, Hugoton is a royalty trust and does not report traditional operating expenses at the Trust level (underlying property costs are deducted by the operator XTO Energy before net profits income reaches the Trust). Note 5 clarifies that Administration expense covers Trustee management, reporting, and professional service fees. This document supplies the Trust's administrative cost figure for the cross-company comparison.
